AppModel

class AppModel[source]

Bases: object

Global state of the application session (singleton).

Attributes:
language_modelLanguage

Supported languages; used by LanguageController.

_instanceAppModel | None, class attribute

The single instance.

_initializedbool, class attribute

Whether the instance was already initialized.

Notes

AppModel() always returns the same object, and its state is set up only on the first call. At that time the language saved in the configuration file (PathConfig.config(), key AppConfig.SETTINGS_GERAL_LANGUAGE, read with QSettings) becomes the current language if it is supported; otherwise Language.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE is used.

Methods

get_instance

Return the single instance of the class.

is_english

Check whether the current language is English.
property current_language: str

Code of the language currently in use, e.g. "pt_BR".

Notes

Setting an unsupported code selects Language.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE instead. The setter does not save the language to the configuration file.
